TD2 Comms: Division

Kelso Recruitment

Agent Alani Kelso is recruited by SHD Features AGENT KELSO, SHD RECRUITER. Contains 6 dialogue exchanges. [1]

Kelso's Apartment

Agent Kelso watches the news reporting on the outbreak Features AGENT KELSO, NEWS ANCHOR. Contains 2 dialogue exchanges. [1]

Broad-Spectrum Antiviral

Kelso briefs Manny on the DCD broad-spectrum antiviral Features AGENT KELSO, MANNY ORTEGA. Contains 7 dialogue exchanges. [1]

Theater Recruitment

Agent Kelso meets with the Theater Leader Odessa Sawyer and agrees to help them however she can Features AGENT KELSO, ODESSA SAWYER. Contains 8 dialogue exchanges. [1]

Agent AWOL

Agent Clark tries to convince Agent Miller to stay on mission Features AGENT CLARK, AGENT MILLER. Contains 10 dialogue exchanges. [1]

Sawyer's Separated

Agent Odessa Sawyer has to leave her husband and daughter when she is activated Features multiple speakers including JTF SOLDIER, MR. SAWYER, ODESSA SAWYER. Contains 13 dialogue exchanges. [1]

Sawyer Reunited

Agent Odessa Sawyer is reunited with her daughter after being discharged from active duty Features ELEANOR SAWYER, ODESSA SAWYER. Contains 8 dialogue exchanges. [1]

Odessa Recruited

Odessa Sawyer, a former SHD agent, is recruited to the leader of the Theater settlement Features ODESSA SAWYER, THOMAS. Contains 10 dialogue exchanges. [1]

Priority Target: Keener

Keener": Update to all agents regarding Keener's status and Rogue Agents in Manhattan Features ANNOUNCER. Contains 1 dialogue exchanges. [1]

Priority Target: Amherst (Update)

Amherst (Update)": Message to all agents regarding Amherst, Green Poison, and Black Friday Features ANNOUNCER. Contains 1 dialogue exchanges. [1]
